decision_conditions: <p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority a revised plan showing the proposed cycle store located within the rear garden along with the proposed elevations and external finish of the proposed cycle stores. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter. </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Design and Access Statement Dated: 19 November 2021;&nbsp;<span style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">A3626 52 E100,&nbsp;A3626 52 E101,&nbsp;A3626 52 E102,&nbsp;A3626 52 E103; A3626 52 E104; A3626 52 E105,&nbsp;3626 52 100B,&nbsp;A3626 52 101B,&nbsp;A3626 52 102C,&nbsp;A3626 52 001</span></span></span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:</p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5">a) a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the frontage of the site, including defensible planting; and </p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5">b) detailed plans to show a external private amenity area for the proposed development bounded by an appropriate boundary treatment of no less than 1.8m in height. </p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm;" class="CM5">Soft landscaping plans shall include planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant containers (all at time of plating) and proposed numbers/densities, a landscape implementation programme. Hard landscaping works shall include: material details, if permeable materials are used full construction details of permeable paving and their maintenance plan. If non permeable material is used, details regarding management of surface water run-off from the proposed hardstanding. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed prior to the first occupation of the development. </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">from the date of planning permission P/4663/21&nbsp;dated 02/03/2022.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">Prior to the occupation of the development, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users </p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">&nbsp; &nbsp; 6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5">The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas.</p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><br></p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans)   attached to planning permission P/4663/21 dated 02/03/2022 to allow change in the proposed external materials from glazing to brick/render and relocation of front entrance door
